footage.description: A footage item: how one medium is interpreted. The medium itself is the node `media.node`.

alpha.description: How the file's alpha channel is interpreted. `Straight`: colour is not multiplied by alpha; `Premultiplied`: colour is multiplied by alpha over `premul_color`; `Ignore`: alpha is ignored: the picture is opaque.

alphabetical.description: Image sequences: the files play one after another in name order and their numbering does not count (otherwise a gap in the numbering is a gap in time). Default false.

codec.description: The codec or file-format name as the importing application reported it (`H.264`, `PNG`, `PSD`). A label; the format of the bytes is the media node's. Default empty.

color_profile.description: The colour space of the file's values; absent: sRGB. `Srgb`: sRGB IEC 61966-2-1 (BT.709 primaries, D65, the sRGB curve); `Rec709`: BT.709 primaries, D65, a pure 2.4 power curve; `Rec2020`: BT.2020 primaries, D65, a pure 2.4 power curve; `DisplayP3`: P3 primaries, D65, the sRGB curve; `AcesCg`: ACEScg: AP1 primaries, ACES white, linear; `Aces2065`: ACES2065-1: AP0 primaries, ACES white, linear; `Rec2100Pq`: BT.2020 primaries, D65, SMPTE ST 2084 (PQ); `Rec2100Hlg`: BT.2020 primaries, D65, hybrid log-gamma.

anyOf.description: Data footage: the `core.motion.data` node that holds the file's text. Null or absent: none.

data.description: Data footage: the `core.motion.data` node that holds the file's text. Null or absent: none.

duration.description: Length of the footage at `frame_rate`; 0 for a still. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

fields.description: Field separation: each field becomes a frame at twice the rate. Default `Off`. `Off`: progressive frames; `UpperFirst`: interlaced; the upper field (even rows, 0-based) is first in time; `LowerFirst`: interlaced; the lower field is first.

frame_rate.description: The rate the footage plays at (after `Conform to frame rate`).

height.description: Height of the picture in its stored pixels.

invert_alpha.description: Alpha is inverted (1 - a) after decoding. Default false.

kind.description: What the medium is used as. `Video`: a movie; `Still`: one picture; `Sequence`: numbered stills played as frames; `Audio`: sound only; `Model`: a 3D model; `Data`: a data file (JSON, CSV, TSV) read by expressions; no picture.

layer.description: The footage is ONE layer of a layered file (a Photoshop document, a PDF / Illustrator page) instead of its merged picture.

embedded.description: A Photoshop smart object: the unique id of its embedded file, which is the footage instead of the layer's pixels.

index.description: Index of the layer record in the file; the bottom layer is 0.

layer_size.description: True: the footage is the layer's own bounds; false: the document's size. Default false.

name.description: The layer's name in the file.

placed.description: A smart object placed with a perspective quad or a warp: the footage is the embedded file as placed, over its placed bounds. Default false.

linear_light.description: The file's values are linear light. Default false.

loop_count.description: How many times the footage plays; 1 = once. Default 1.

missing.description: The application's own flag that the file could not be found when it last looked. Default false.

anyOf.description: The file's own rate when `frame_rate` was conformed to another; null: not conformed.

native_rate.description: The file's own rate when `frame_rate` was conformed to another; null: not conformed.

page.description: PDF / Illustrator footage: the page shown, 0-based. Default 0.

pixel_aspect.description: Pixel aspect ratio: width of one stored pixel / its height. 1 = square.

premul_color.description: The matte colour premultiplied alpha is over: r, g, b 0..1 (binary32). Default black.

preserve_rgb.description: The file's values enter the composition unconverted (no colour profile, no linear-light interpretation, no working-space conversion). Default false.

start_timecode.description: The frame number (at `frame_rate`) the footage's timecode shows at its first frame; absent: 0. It only relabels source time.

width.description: Width of the picture in its stored pixels; 0 when there is none.

frame_rate.description: A frame rate as an exact fraction: num / den frames per second (24000/1001, 25/1...). One frame lasts 254016000000 * den / num ticks.

media_ref.description: Where the bytes of a footage file are: in this package, or nowhere.

frame_origins.description: Image sequences: the paths of the frames in playing order, as they were imported (notes). With a node, frame i is the node's file number i (profile document 3.6). Default empty.

items.description: The path one frame was imported from.

anyOf.description: The media node (`core.media.source`, `core.media.png`, `core.media.text` or `x.effectcraft.media`) that holds the file - for an image sequence, every frame. Null: the bytes are NOT in this package (the file was missing when the document was saved, or the footage never had one); the footage is offline.

node.description: The media node (`core.media.source`, `core.media.png`, `core.media.text` or `x.effectcraft.media`) that holds the file - for an image sequence, every frame. Null: the bytes are NOT in this package (the file was missing when the document was saved, or the footage never had one); the footage is offline.

origin.description: The path the footage was imported from: a note of where the file WAS. It is not part of the package and no reader may treat it as a place to read from; an editing application shows it for an offline item so the user can find the file again. Empty when there was none.

proxy.description: A proxy: a stand-in medium used instead of the item when `enabled` is true and the render allows proxies.

footage.description: The stand-in, interpreted like any footage. Its medium is a file the user attached: an imported original, stamped `authored` (nothing records whether or how it was made from the item).

description: One footage or solid item of the project.

id.description: The item's id: unique in the project, never reused.

Solid.description: A solid: a source of `width` x `height` pixels, every pixel the colour, opaque.

color.description: r, g, b: 0..1, binary32, authored-colour encoding (profile document 6.8).

kind.description: What the item is: exactly one key. `Footage`: a medium and its interpretation. `Solid`: a rectangle of one colour.

label.description: The item's label. A colour label: a display aid with no effect on the picture.

anyOf.description: Id of the folder the item is in; null: the project's root.

parent.description: Id of the folder the item is in; null: the project's root.

anyOf.description: The item's proxy; null or absent: none.

proxy.description: The item's proxy; null or absent: none.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

title: core.motion.item
